verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an automated, secured data room that collects completed documents and smart-links them to the cap table, so the diligence-ready repository is clearly there. The evidence never shows the story's core action: granting permissioned access to external counsel or investors. Missing for 10: documented external sharing with counsel/investors, permission or role controls on data room access, shareable cap table views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
